# QECTOR Decoder v3 (v1.0.0) Full Context

QECTOR Decoder v3 is a production-grade Python and Rust quantum error correction decoder package by Guillaume Lessard / QECTOR Lab. v1.0.0 (2026-08-06) is the first stable release.

## Public Install

pip install qector-decoder-v3==1.0.0

## Verification Command

- python -c "import qector_decoder_v3 as qd; print(qd.__version__)" → 1.0.0
- qector-doctor (15-point environment check)

## Stable Release Facts (v1.0.0, 2026-08-06, commit 75cd45c)

First stable release: 25+ decoder configurations across API stability tiers (stable/beta/experimental). New families: ColourCodeDecoder (opt-in cluster_bposd), TwoStageDecoder, AmbiguityClusterDecoder. Relay-BP (bp_method="relay"), CS-OSD(lambda, w), LLR damping in BP-OSD. CUDA batch decoder accepts edge_weights and precision="f64". Sinter entry points (qector_blossom, qector_belief, qector_unionfind, qector_sparse_blossom, qector_bp_osd, qector_batch, qector_cuda_batch) and qiskit-qec plugin registered — `sinter.collect()` needs no custom_decoders=. CLI: `qector decode` / `qector bench` / `qector serve`; `qector-doctor`. `from qector_decoder_v3.pymatching import Matching` shim. 15 binary wheels (cp39–cp313, Windows amd64, Linux x86_64 manylinux_2_17, macOS 11.0+ arm64), PyPI Trusted Publishing + Sigstore attestation, no sdist. PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. OpenCL and HybridCascadeDecoder are source-build only (not in wheels).

## Benchmark Policy

The only citable benchmark figures are the verified v0.7.0 artifacts at /benchmarks/v0.7.0/: REPORT.md, summary.json, benchmarks.csv (54 rows, zero unfaithful corrections), and VERIFIED_APPLE_TO_APPLE_REPORT.pdf. Peak throughput 11,540,387 shots/s (FastUnionFind, 5-qubit repetition code, package MCP server); 42/42 syndrome-faithfulness cases; 13 MCP tools. Apple-to-apple vs PyMatching: comparable, PyMatching often slightly ahead on the synchronized batch — no speedup multiplier claimed. Pre-v0.7.0 comparison tables are formally withdrawn. v1.0.0 publishes no new headline figures — run `qector bench` for your own hardware.

## Verified Tools (MCP, 13)

decode_syndrome, batch_decode, decode_hyperedge, decode_syndrome_blossom, batch_decode_blossom, decode_syndrome_cascade, benchmark_decoder, run_ler_benchmark, get_decoder_info, get_backend_health, clear_decoder_cache, get_server_env, recommend_decoder.

## Decoders & Families

25+ decoder configurations in v1.0.0: union_find, fast_union_find, blossom, sparse_blossom, bp_osd, auto, hybrid, lookup_table, predecoded, auto_router, hybrid_cascade (source builds), gnn_belief_matching, belief_matching, two_stage, ambiguity_cluster, colour_code (opt-in cluster_bposd), plus options (relay BP, CS-OSD, LLR damping, CUDA f64 edge_weights). 10 code families: repetition, ring, rotated_surface, unrotated_surface, toric, heavy_hex, hypergraph_product, bicycle, bivariate_bicycle, color_code.

## Workbench App

QECTOR Workbench v0.5.2: free cross-platform GUI (Windows, Linux, macOS), 56 MCP tools, 16 decoders, 10 code families, offline operation, bundled qector_decoder_v3 0.7.0 backend. GitHub: https://github.com/qectorlab/qector-decoder-workbench/releases/
